SELECT
  CASE WHEN t.order_installments > 1 THEN 'installment' ELSE 'single' END AS payment_installment_group,
  AVG(t.order_total) AS average_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    COALESCE(ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)), 0) AS order_total,
    COALESCE(MAX(op.payment_installments), 1) AS order_installments
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN order_payments op
    ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t
GROUP BY CASE WHEN t.order_installments > 1 THEN 'installment' ELSE 'single' END
ORDER BY payment_installment_group;
